description: This file defines the PhpTransliteration class implementing character-by-character transliteration without PECL extensions, including methods for removing diacritics and transliterating strings based on language-specific and generic Unicode mappings.
external_files: data files in the specified data directory (not explicitly listed in code)

classes.name: PhpTransliteration
classes.description: A class implementing transliteration functionality, including diacritics removal and Unicode character replacement based on language and generic mappings.

methods.name: removeDiacritics
methods.description: Removes diacritics from a string by replacing accented characters with their base ASCII equivalents.

methods.name: transliterate
methods.description: Transliterates a string into ASCII, handling unknown characters and length limits.

methods.name: ordUTF8
methods.description: Calculates the Unicode code point of a UTF-8 character.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces a Unicode character with its transliteration based on language-specific or generic mappings.

methods.name: lookupReplacement
methods.description: Looks up the ASCII replacement for a Unicode character code in the generic map.

methods.name: readLanguageOverrides
methods.description: Loads language-specific transliteration overrides from data files.

methods.name: readGenericData
methods.description: Loads generic transliteration data for a Unicode character bank from data files.
